source.name: Kartalhaber: Beşiktaş'a Basketbolda Yeni Sponsor: Gain ile Anlaşma Sağlandı
source.quote: Beşiktaş Kulübü, erkek basketbol takımı için içerik platformu Gain ile isim ve forma göğüs sponsorluğu anlaşması imzaladı. Anlaşma, 2025-2026 sezonunu kapsıyor.
source.note: Name and chest sponsor (Gain logo on the chest), deal signed for 2025-2026. The team carried the name into 2026-27: the Turkish Basketball Federation's 26 June 2026 announcement (tbf.org.tr, blocked to scripts) and TurkSportPlatform the same day (https://turksportplatform.com/besiktas-gain-2026-27-sezonunda-euroleaguee-katiliyor/, opened 2026-10-01: 'Yeni sezonda EuroLeague'de yer alacak Beşiktaş GAIN') welcome 'Beşiktaş GAIN' into the 2026-27 EuroLeague, so the name-and-chest sponsor continues; no separate 2026-27 chest announcement was found.

source.name: İHA: Tera Holding, Beşiktaş JK'nin futbol ve basketbol takımlarına forma sırt sponsoru oldu
source.quote: Tera, 2026-2027 sezonundan itibaren iki sezon boyunca Beşiktaş Futbol A Takımı'nın, 2026-2027 sezonunda ise Beşiktaş Erkek Basketbol Takımı'nın forma sırt sponsoru olarak yer alacak.
source.note: Two-year back-of-shirt deal signed 17 August 2026 covering the football A team and, for 2026-27, the men's basketball team. After Turkey's SPK moved against Tera funds, Beşiktaş took the Tera logo off the shirts for the 17-18 September 2026 Marseille match (Memur Haber 365, https://www.memurhaber365.com/besiktas-formasinda-tera-surprizi-spk-karari-sonrasi-besiktas-hissesi-neden-coktu/), with no official termination announced; whether the logo returns is unresolved.

source.name: Duhuliye: İyi Finans, Erkek Basketbol Takımımızın Forma Sırt Alt Sponsoru Oldu (club statement)
source.quote: İyi Finans, 2026-27 sezonu sonuna kadar Erkek Basketbol Takımımızın formasının sırt alt kısmında yer alacak.
source.note: Below the back number (sırt alt), to the end of 2026-27. Duhuliye reproduces the club's own statement; the original bjk.com.tr announcement (haber/95166) blocks scripts.

summary: Gain is the name and chest sponsor (the team plays as Beşiktaş Gain in the 2026-27 EuroLeague); Tera Holding was announced as back sponsor for 2026-27 but was taken off the shirts in September 2026 after Turkey's fund-crisis crackdown, with no official termination announced; İyi Finans sits below the back number until the end of the season. Not complete: sleeves, shorts, patches and the kit maker for 2026-27 are unsourced (Honor, signed April 2026, was on the 2025-26 jersey and Govee was the 2025-26 shorts-back sponsor, with no 2026-27 source found for either).
